subject: Physics
title: Nuclei
summary: Nucleus protons (Z) aur neutrons (N) se bana hai; A = Z + N mass number. Iska size A^{1/3} ke saath badhta hai, isliye har nucleus ki density lagbhag same (~2.3 × 10¹⁷ kg/m³) hoti hai.
Nucleus ka mass uske protons + neutrons ke alag-alag mass se KAM hota hai. Ye kami (mass defect) E = mc² se binding energy ban jaati hai — nucleus ko todne ke liye itni energy chahiye.

Binding energy per nucleon (BE/A) stability ka naap hai. Ye A ≈ 56 (iron) ke paas sabse zyada (~8.8 MeV) hai. Isliye bhaari nucleus tootne (fission) aur halke nuclei judne (fusion) — dono mein energy nikalti hai.
Nuclear force bahut strong, short-range (~2–3 fm), charge-independent aur attractive hai (bahut paas jaane par repulsive).

formulas.name: Notation and composition
formulas.formula: ᴬ_Z X:  Z = protons,  N = A − Z = neutrons

formulas.name: Nuclear radius
formulas.formula: R = R₀ A^{1/3},   R₀ ≈ 1.2 fm (1 fm = 10⁻¹⁵ m)

formulas.name: Nuclear density
formulas.formula: ρ = 3 m_u / (4π R₀³) ≈ 2.3 × 10¹⁷ kg/m³  (A se independent)
formulas.mistake: Har nucleus ki density same — A badhne se nahi badalti.

formulas.name: Atomic mass unit
formulas.formula: 1 u = 1/12 × (¹²C atom ka mass) = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg ≡ 931.5 MeV/c²
formulas.note: 1 u × c² = 931.5 MeV seedha use karo.

formulas.name: Mass–energy relation
formulas.when: Mass ka energy mein badalna (aur ulta).

formulas.name: Mass defect
formulas.formula: Δm = [Z m_p + (A − Z) m_n] − M_nucleus   (atomic masses ho to m_p ki jagah m_H lo)
formulas.note: Atomic mass mein electrons bhi hote hain — dono taraf same rakho.

formulas.name: Binding energy
formulas.when: Nucleus ko poori tarah todne ki energy.

formulas.name: Binding energy per nucleon
formulas.formula: BE/A;   peak ≈ 8.8 MeV near A ≈ 56;   ≈ 8 MeV for 30 < A < 170
formulas.mistake: Zyada BE/A = zyada stable (total BE nahi).

formulas.name: Q-value of a reaction
formulas.formula: Q = (Σ m_reactants − Σ m_products) c² = Σ BE_products − Σ BE_reactants
formulas.when: Reaction mein energy nikli ya lagi.

formulas.name: Nuclear fission
formulas.note: Ek fission mein ~200 MeV, yaani ~0.9 MeV per nucleon.

formulas.name: Nuclear fusion
formulas.formula: Sun: 4 ¹H → ⁴He + 2e⁺ + 2ν + 26.7 MeV;   ²H + ²H → ³He + n + 3.27 MeV
formulas.note: Bahut zyada temperature (~10⁷ K) chahiye taaki Coulomb repulsion paar ho.

examples.title: Nucleus ka size
examples.problem: ²⁷Al ka radius? ¹²⁵Te ka radius kitna guna?

examples.title: Nuclear density
examples.problem: Nuclear matter ki density nikaalo (m_u = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, R₀ = 1.2 fm).
examples.solution: ρ = A m_u / (4/3 π R₀³ A) = 3 m_u/(4πR₀³) ≈ 2.3 × 10¹⁷ kg/m³ — paani se ~10¹⁴ guna zyada, aur A par depend nahi.

examples.title: 1 g mass ki energy
examples.problem: 1 g mass poora energy mein badal jaaye to?
examples.solution: E = mc² = 10⁻³ × (3 × 10⁸)² = 9.0 × 10¹³ J — ek bade sheher ki kai dino ki bijli.

examples.title: 1 kg U-235 ka fission
examples.problem: Har fission 200 MeV de. 1 kg ²³⁵U se kitni energy?

examples.title: BE/A se fission energy
examples.problem: A = 240 (BE/A = 7.6 MeV) wala nucleus do A = 120 (BE/A = 8.5 MeV) nuclei mein toot-ta hai. Energy?

topics.title: Nucleus ki banawat
topics.explain: Protons + neutrons = nucleons. Same Z, alag A wale atoms (jaise ¹H, ²H, ³H) chemically same hote hain. Nucleus ka size ~fm (10⁻¹⁵ m), atom ka ~Å (10⁻¹⁰ m) — atom nucleus se ~10⁵ guna bada.

topics.title: Atomic masses aur mass spectrometer
topics.explain: Atomic masses u mein naapi jaati hain (¹²C = exactly 12 u). Ye masses whole numbers nahi hote — yahi chhota farak mass defect ka raaz hai.

topics.title: Mass defect se binding energy
topics.explain: Nucleons ko jodne par kuch mass energy ban kar nikal jaata hai. Wahi energy wapas do to nucleus toot-ta hai. Isliye BE = Δm c².

topics.title: BE/A curve
topics.explain: A chhota: BE/A tezi se badhta hai (He-4 ek peak). A ≈ 56 (Fe) par maximum ~8.8 MeV. A bada: dheere ghat-ta hai (U ~7.6 MeV). Curve ka matlab: beech ke nuclei sabse stable; bhaari ke liye fission, halke ke liye fusion energy deta hai.

topics.title: Nuclear force ke gun
topics.explain: Sabse strong force (Coulomb se ~100 guna), bahut short range (~2–3 fm), p-p, n-n, p-n mein barabar (charge-independent), saturate hoti hai (har nucleon sirf paas wale padosiyon se judta hai) — isliye BE/A lagbhag constant hai.

topics.title: Fission aur chain reaction
topics.explain: Slow neutron ²³⁵U ko todta hai, 2–3 naye neutrons nikalte hain jo aur fission karte hain. Controlled chain reaction = nuclear reactor (moderator neutrons dheeme karta hai, control rods (Cd/B) neutrons sokhte hain). Uncontrolled = atom bomb.

topics.title: Fusion aur taare
topics.explain: Halke nuclei judkar bhaari nucleus — per unit mass fission se zyada energy. Positive nuclei ko paas laane ke liye bahut garmi chahiye (thermonuclear). Sooraj ki energy hydrogen ke helium mein fusion se aati hai.

topics.title: Syllabus note
topics.explain: Radioactivity (alpha, beta, gamma ke gun aur decay law, half-life) aur isotopes/isobars/isotones ki definitions JEE Main aur NEET dono ke current (2024 se revised) syllabus se hata di gayi hain. Is chapter ka focus: size, density, mass defect, binding energy, BE/A curve, fission, fusion.

ratta: R = 1.2 A^{1/3} fm;  ρ ≈ 2.3 × 10¹⁷ kg/m³ (sabka same).
BE = Δm × 931.5 MeV;  zyada BE/A = zyada stable.
Fission ≈ 200 MeV per ²³⁵U;  sun fusion 26.7 MeV per He-4.
Nuclear force: strong, short-range, charge-independent, saturating.
